Your privacy matters to us. This Privacy Policy explains what personal information Beauty Intelligent Wellness (BIW) collects, how we use it, and the choices you have regarding your data. By using our services, website, or digital platforms, you agree to the practices described in this policy. This policy applies to all BIW branches: Bashundhara Female Branch, Bashundhara Male Branch, and Uttara Female Branch.
When you book an appointment, create a membership account, purchase a product, or contact us, we may collect:
• Payment information (processed securely; we do not store card details)
• Medical history, skin type, and health disclosures relevant to your treatment
• Preferences and feedback submitted through forms or surveys
• Branch preference and visit history across all BIW locations
When you visit our website or digital platforms, we may automatically collect:
• Pages visited and time spent on the site

We may receive information about you from third-party platforms where you have chosen to interact with BIW, including Facebook, Instagram, and Google, in accordance with those platforms' own privacy settings.
We use the information we collect for the following purposes:
• To confirm and manage your bookings and appointments across all branches
• To deliver services and provide post-treatment follow-up
• To process payments and manage your membership account
• To send appointment reminders, service updates, and promotional communications where you have opted in
• To personalise your wellness experience and service recommendations
• To improve our services, website, and digital platforms
• To comply with legal obligations and resolve disputes
• To conduct internal analytics and business performance reporting across all branches

We may send you marketing messages about BIW services, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and wellness content by SMS, email, push notification, or social media, but only where you have provided consent to do so.

You may opt out of marketing communications at any time by contacting us directly or using the unsubscribe mechanism included in our messages. Opting out of marketing does not affect communications necessary for your bookings or account management.

Our website uses cookies to improve your browsing experience, remember your preferences, and analyse site traffic. You may choose to disable cookies through your browser settings; however, some features of our website may not function correctly if cookies are disabled.
BIW does not sell your personal data. We may share your data with trusted third parties only in the following circumstances:
• Service providers who assist in operating our website, booking system, payment processing, or marketing platforms, under strict confidentiality obligations
• Professional advisors such as legal counsel or auditors where required
• Regulatory or government authorities where required by law
All third-party partners are required to handle your data in accordance with applicable privacy laws and our contractual requirements.

We retain your personal data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, including for legal, accounting, and regulatory requirements. Health and treatment records are retained for a minimum of five years in accordance with standard medical-aesthetic practice.

BIW implements appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorised access, loss, destruction, or alteration. These include secure servers, encrypted payment processing, and access controls on all systems holding client data across all branches.
• Access the personal data we hold about you
• Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
• Request deletion of your data where we have no legal obligation to retain it
• Withdraw consent for marketing communications at any time
• Lodge a complaint with the relevant regulatory authority if you believe your data has been mishandled
BIW's services are intended for individuals aged 16 and above. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under the age of 16 without parental consent.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The most current version will always be published on our website with an updated effective date.
For any privacy-related enquiries, requests, or complaints, please contact us at any BIW branch or via email at info@biw.com.bd.

At BIW, we respect your time and ask that you respect ours. This policy outlines the terms under which appointments may be cancelled, rescheduled, or refunded across all BIW branches. Please read carefully before making a booking.
All appointment cancellations must be communicated to BIW a minimum of 12 hours before the scheduled appointment time. Cancellations received within the required window will not attract any penalty.
To cancel an appointment, clients must contact the relevant BIW branch through one of the following:
• Phone or WhatsApp to the branch's registered number
• Email to info@biw.com.bd with the branch name and appointment details
A cancellation is only confirmed once a BIW team member has acknowledged the request. Please do not assume cancellation is complete without confirmation.
Cancellations made less than 12 hours before the scheduled appointment will be treated as a late cancellation. In such cases:
• Pre-paid single session appointments: no refund will be issued. The session will be forfeited.
• Membership holders: one session credit will be deducted from your active membership balance.
• Package holders: one treatment session from the relevant package will be marked as used.

BIW acknowledges that genuine emergencies occur. Late cancellation charges may be waived at management's discretion in cases of documented medical emergency or serious unforeseen circumstances. Waiver requests must be submitted within 24 hours of the missed appointment.
A no-show is defined as failing to attend a confirmed appointment without any prior notice. No-shows are treated as forfeited sessions and no refund, credit, or rescheduling will be offered.
Clients with two or more no-show incidents within a 90-day period may be required to pay a non-refundable booking deposit for future appointments, at BIW's discretion.
Appointments may be rescheduled free of charge provided a minimum of 12 hours' notice is given. Rescheduling to a different branch is permitted subject to availability at that branch.
Appointments may be rescheduled a maximum of two times. Beyond two rescheduling requests, BIW may require the client to re-book as a new appointment.
Same-day rescheduling (changes made less than 12 hours before the appointment) will be treated as a late cancellation and the original session will be forfeited.

BIW does not offer refunds for services that have been delivered and completed. If you are dissatisfied with your treatment outcome, please contact the branch within 48 hours and a member of our team will arrange a consultation to address your concerns.
Refunds for unused pre-paid session packages are available under the following conditions:
• A refund request must be submitted in writing within 14 days of the original purchase date.
• Refunds will be calculated based on the number of sessions used, deducting the standard walk-in rate (not the package rate) for each session already taken, subtracted from the total amount paid.
• Any remaining balance after this calculation will be refunded within 7 to 14 working days via the original payment method.
No refund will be issued for packages where more than 50% of the sessions have already been used.
Packages purchased at promotional or discounted rates are non-refundable. They may be transferred to an eligible replacement product or session of equal value at BIW's discretion.

New membership subscribers have a 7-day cooling-off period from the date of first payment. If you wish to cancel your membership within this window and have not used any membership benefits, you are entitled to a full refund.
After the 7-day cooling-off period, membership cancellations will take effect at the end of the current billing cycle. No partial refunds will be issued for unused days within a paid billing period.
Membership cancellation requests must be submitted in writing to BIW a minimum of 7 days before the next billing date to avoid the subsequent charge.

Members may opt to freeze their membership once per year for up to 30 days rather than cancelling. During the freeze period, no charges will be applied and access to membership benefits will be suspended. The membership will automatically resume at the end of the agreed freeze period.
Retail products purchased at any BIW branch may be returned or exchanged under the following conditions:
• The product is unused and in its original sealed packaging.
• The return request is made within 7 days of purchase with valid proof of purchase.
• The product has not been personalised or specially ordered.

BIW does not accept returns on opened skincare, wellness, or consumable products for hygiene reasons, except where the product is found to be defective or damaged at the time of purchase. In such cases, a replacement or full refund will be provided.
BIW reserves the right to cancel or reschedule an appointment in cases of staff unavailability, facility issues, or unforeseen circumstances at any branch. In such cases:
• Clients will be notified as soon as possible by phone or message.
• A full refund or priority rescheduling at the same or alternative branch will be offered at the client's preference.
• BIW's liability in such cases is limited to the amount paid for the affected appointment.
All refund requests must be submitted in writing. To initiate a refund, please contact the relevant branch or reach us at:
• WhatsApp or phone: to your branch's registered business number
• Bashundhara Female Branch: Bashundhara Adept NR Complex, Building Lift-3, KFC/Pizza Hut Main Gate, Dhaka 1229
• Bashundhara Male Branch: Bashundhara Adept NR Complex, Building Lift-3, KFC/Pizza Hut Main Gate, Dhaka 1229

Please include your full name, contact number, branch visited, appointment or purchase date, and reason for the refund request. Approved refunds will be processed within 7 to 14 working days via the original payment method.
BIW reserves the right to update this policy at any time. The current version will always be available on our website. Bookings made after a policy update are subject to the new terms.
